1. (Currently amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product; and __automatically alerting a user when the generated at least use information indicates a deviation from a predicted usage pattern__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __scanning or reading__ the unique identifier from the package.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises receiving information stored in a radio frequency identification tag __and decoding the received information__.

4. (Originally presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising: searching a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier.

5. (Originally presented) The method of claim 4, wherein searching the data store comprises transmitting the unique identifier to the data store over a network.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form __suitable for display to the user__.

7. (Originally presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving the at least use information from the data store.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of __a recommended time__ when a next dose of the product is to be taken, __a recorded time__ when a previous dose of a product was taken, and __whether__ a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Originally presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving user information regarding use of the product from a user.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving an input through __a user interface of__ a user device.

11. (Originally presented) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving the user information regarding use of the product stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

12. (Originally presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving information from a secondary device.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium and a list of users, __and wherein the unique identifier is associated with specific product lot or batch information__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual __only upon receiving authentication credentials from the authorized individual__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving a user profile, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information based at least partially on the user profile __and user-specific medical or health parameters__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising generating an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, __wherein the alert is generated when actual usage deviates from predicted usage__.

17. (Originally presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received.

18. (Originally presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying __a caregiver or administrator providing__ the product.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier; and generating a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier, __wherein the wrong user alert is transmitted to a monitoring system__.

21. (Originally presented) The method of claim 20, further comprising generating one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, wherein __the first user comprises a patient and__ the second unique identifier identifies a second user providing the product to the first user, the method further comprising: storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user __and a timestamp of such provision__.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of __the second user providing__ the product.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for __a specific user based on user-specific parameters__.

25. (Currently amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the user device further configured to communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information, __and wherein the user device automatically generates alerts when usage deviates from predicted patterns__.

26. (Currently amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network, __and wherein the computing device includes a processor that executes instructions to automatically compare actual usage against predicted usage patterns and generate alerts__.

27. (Cancelled)

28. (Currently amended) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions for: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product; and __automatically alerting a user when the generated at least use information indicates a deviation from a predicted usage pattern__.
